## Package purpose

What workflow does the package support, and why should it live in the Ostrin
ecosystem?

## API sketch

Show a small source example using the proposed API.

## Current implementation

Link existing source, tests or design notes. Mark every unimplemented part as
planned or experimental.

## Verification and ownership

Describe interpreter/native/WASI coverage, determinism requirements and who can
maintain the package.
